remarks: Pristine move in ready five-bedroom Colonial residence situated on 2.9 acres of parklike grounds. Spanning over 6,000 square feet, this home features an open floor plan with formal rooms, elegant moldings, graceful archways and French doors. The interior includes a gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances, a marble center seating island, breakfast room with coffee bar, all which open into a family room with vaulted ceilings and a fireplace. Additional highlights include a library/office with built-ins, and a primary suite featuring a private balcony overlooking the pond, a sitting area, and a marble bathroom.  The property also includes a separate-entry apt. equipped with a kitchenette, a large living and dining area, a bedroom, and a full bath. The home is finished with hardwood flooring, custom millwork, and three fireplaces. Exterior amenities include a spacious deck and room for 5 cars, a heated main level 3 car garage, large mudroom, and an additional two-car garage on the lower level.   The residence is conveniently located near local schools, the village center, Metro-North New Canaan station, The Field Club, and the Merritt Parkway.
